To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

■ Abnormal HRC is associated with sepsis and other adverse conditions. ■ The HeRO monitor detects abnormal HRC and provides a risk score to assist clinicians in early recognition and intervention. ■ A large RCT demonstrated that use of the HeRo score in the NICU was associated with a 22% reduction in mortality. ■ Current research is aimed at developing new algorithms to improve outcomes in the NICU.

■ HeRO monitoring is a novel, noninvasive, bedside monitor that can predict the onset of sepsis and other adverse outcomes in the NICU. ■ The monitor is a validated clinical decision support tool that has demonstrated a 22% reduction in mortality in VLBW infants. ■ HeRO monitoring provides a new window into autonomic nervous dysfunction in preterm infants and may have applications beyond the NICU. 111 Scanned Page
